title: Launch policy
text: The launch code is L-7781. The primary window opens at 06:30 UTC.

title: Warranty
text: The warranty code is W-9900. Claims must be submitted within 30 days.

title: Travel
text: Book business class for flights longer than four hours. The travel portal code is TR-42.

title: Visitor security
text: Visitors receive a blue badge at north reception. The badge code is VB-42.
